summary: Replace nodes from one changed fixture file
description: After one fixture file changes, incremental update replaces nodes and edges sourced from that file and leaves other files' entries in the graph input.
scope: Add incremental_update(graph, changed_path, new_edges) in src/living_graph/scan.py
Remove existing nodes and edges whose source_path equals changed_path
Keep edges from a different source_path
acceptanceCriteria: incremental_update(graph, 'tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot', new_edges) drops old simple_test.robot edges and inserts new_edges.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Rebuilding nodes with nodes_from_edges is allowed. Do not require unchanged-file nodes to be the same Python objects.

subtasks.title: Replace one file's nodes and edges
subtasks.summary: Drop old rows for changed_path. Insert new_edges. Keep other files.
scope: Add incremental_update(graph, changed_path, new_edges) in src/living_graph/scan.py
Remove existing nodes and edges whose source_path equals changed_path
Keep edges from a different source_path
dataExamples: Existing graph has an edge from tests/fixtures/simple_test.robot and one from tests/fixtures/simple_library.py.
After update, the library edge remains and the robot edges match new_edges.
instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_incremental_replace.py first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_incremental_replace.py -q and confirm failure.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_incremental_replace.py -q and stop when it passes.
